items.name: Early Years
items.desc: Faction output is reduced for the first ten years.

items.name: Annexation Fever
items.desc: The people of this planet are celebrating their integration into a more advanced civilization.

items.name: Angry
items.desc: Angry at the failure to confront the subterranean aliens on this world about the destructive earthquakes they are causing.

items.name: Drought
items.desc: Suffering from a distinct lack of moisture.

items.name: Hazardous Weather
items.desc: This world suffers from unstable weather patterns, with violent storms frequently appearing out of nowhere to wreak havoc on the surface.

items.name: Hostile Fauna
items.desc: This world has evolved extremely Hostile Fauna, and the surface is rife with lethal predators waiting to ambush their next meal. Studying the creature's biology offers excellent research opportunities.

items.name: Weak Magnetic Field
items.desc: Although habitable, this world has a weak magnetic field that offers little protection against cosmic radiation.

items.name: Strong Magnetic Field
items.desc: This planet has an abnormally high magnetic field and will interfere with many of our instruments and computers. Mitigating these effects will help inform field manipulation research.

items.name: Unstable Tectonics
items.desc: This world has very unstable plate tectonics and is prone to massive earthquakes and volcanic activity.

items.name: Tidal Locked
items.desc: This world is tidally locked around its star, meaning that one side always has daylight while the other is locked in eternal darkness. If life exists here, it is likely limited to the twilight regions where the two sides meet.

items.name: Chthonian Planet
items.desc: This planet was once a gas giant, but its proximity to its star has burned away the thick atmosphere. All that remains now is a super-dense and mineral rich metallic core.

items.name: Asteroid Impacts
items.desc: The orbital path this world takes around its star is littered with small asteroids, meteors, and comet swarms. Large impacts on the surface occur at an alarming frequency.

items.name: Extensive Moon System
items.desc: This gas giant has an unusually large amount of natural satellites. Hundreds of small moons and moonlets orbit the planet.

items.name: Carbon World
items.desc: This world has been formed mostly out of carbon, and contains little oxygen.

items.name: Wild Storms
items.desc: Spectacular electrical storms wrack this planet's atmosphere on a semi-regular basis.

items.name: High Quality Minerals
items.desc: An abundance of high quality minerals in this planet's crust makes mining here a lucrative business.

items.name: Exceptional Quality Minerals
items.desc: The exceptional quality of the minerals in this planet's crust provides a truly staggering opportunity for mining.

items.name: Poor Quality Minerals
items.desc: It is unknown if this planet simply formed this way, or if some unknown race once stripped it of its more valuable resources. However, we do know that the minerals present on this planet are of unusually poor quality.

items.name: Titanic Life
items.desc: The lifeforms of this planet are built on a massive scale and can be incredibly dangerous even without meaning any harm.

items.name: Delicious Titans
items.desc: Harvesting the Titanic life for research data has had an unexpected side benefit: They taste great!

items.name: Delicious Titans
items.desc: Harvesting the Titanic life for research data has had an unexpected side benefit: They taste great!

items.name: Delicious Titans
items.desc: Harvesting the Titanic life for research data has had an unexpected side benefit: They taste great!

items.name: Delicious Titans
items.desc: Harvesting the Titanic life for research data has had an unexpected side benefit: They taste great!

items.name: Asteroid Belt
items.desc: This planet has a belt of minor asteroids orbiting around it. Most likely caused by a tiny moon destroyed in a collision with another planetary body, the debris field provides ample but engineeringly complex mining opportunities.

items.name: Natural Beauty
items.desc: The scenery on this planet is simply beautiful, anyone living on this planet will be constantly finding new wonders to behold.

items.name: Atmospheric Aphrodisiac
items.desc: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.

items.name: Atmospheric Hallucinogen
items.desc: The air of this planet contains a natural hallucinogen. While this does keep people happy, and indeed seems to aid the visualization of some of the more esoteric Physics problems, it also distracts people from other work.

items.name: Filtered Atmospheric Hallucinogen
items.desc: The air of this planet once contained a natural hallucinogen. Now, with the aid of massive filters, the effect has been diluted. This has reduced the benefits it once gave, but has also eliminated the negatives.

items.name: Lush
items.desc: Life thrives here, the fauna is plentiful and the flora grows rapidly.

items.name: Bleak
items.desc: Life struggles to survive here, and while some clings to a tenacious existence, it is frail and sickly. These issues will harm food production.

items.name: Irradiated
items.desc: Some long-ago calamity rendered this planet rather heavily irradiated.

items.name: Low Gravity
items.desc: This planet has an unusually low density and therefore much lower gravity than most planets of comparable size.

items.name: High Gravity
items.desc: This planet is unusually dense and so has uncomfortably high gravity.

items.name: Abundant Geothermal Activity
items.desc: This planet has many accessible geothermal hot spots. While this poses some engineering challenges, it also provides extra energy generation opportunities.

items.name: Subterranean Wildlife
items.desc: This planet has a thriving underground lithotrophic ecosystem. Herds of mild mineral-crunching subterranean creatures dig out large caverns, leaving them available for mining and colony use. The animals provide unique research opportunities for the miners who direct the packs to valuable mineral deposits.

items.name: Rich Microflora
items.desc: The soil of this world is home to a robust and highly productive microflora ecosystem, allowing for rich farming and research opportunities.

items.name: Extremophile Lifeforms
items.desc: Even in a world of extreme heat and deadly lava, life finds a way.

items.name: High Quality Minerals
items.desc: An abundance of high quality minerals in this planet's crust makes mining here a lucrative business.

items.name: Exceptional Quality Minerals
items.desc: The exceptional quality of the minerals in this planet's crust provides a truly staggering opportunity for mining.

items.name: Poor Quality Minerals
items.desc: It is unknown if this planet simply formed this way, or if some unknown race once stripped it of its more valuable resources. However, we do know that the minerals present on this planet are of unusually poor quality.

items.name: Subterranean Wildlife
items.desc: This planet has a thriving underground lithotrophic ecosystem. Herds of mild mineral-crunching subterranean creatures dig out large caverns, leaving them available for mining and colony use. The animals provide unique research opportunities for the miners who direct the packs to valuable mineral deposits.

items.name: Asteroid Impacts
items.desc: The orbital path this world takes around its star is littered with small asteroids, meteors, and comet swarms. Large impacts on the surface occur at an alarming frequency.

items.name: Asteroid Belt
items.desc: This planet has a belt of minor asteroids orbiting around it. Most likely caused by a tiny moon destroyed in a collision with another planetary body, the debris field provides ample but engineeringly complex mining opportunities.

items.name: Crystal Lake
items.desc: Vast crystals thrumming with heat and warm light slowly rise from this pool of lava.

items.name: Hollow Planet
items.desc: Beneath the surface, immense caverns remain, hollow echoes of a planet shaped by fire.

items.name: Lavafalls
items.desc: Lava flows freely here, spilling over a steep incline in a natural pyrotechnic display.

items.name: Hellish Oasis
items.desc: A small and green continent, protected by a high mountain range from the raging inferno beyond. The unique flora and fauna stand in stark contrast to the desolation that lies just beyond the mountains.

items.name: Migrating Forests
items.desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

items.name: Docile Migrating Forests
items.desc: §W§YMigrating Forest Reserve§! added, improving £society£ §YSociety Research§! on the planet.§!\n\nThe wandering forests on this world now avoid populated areas and no longer cause damage to settlements. Their presence still limits the amount of free land available to colonists.

items.name: Dead Space Creatures
items.desc: This gas giant served as an ancient graveyard for a species of spacefaring creatures. Many corpses can still be found in orbit, offering valuable research.

items.name: Starship Graveyard
items.desc: A great battle took place in orbit of this world millennia ago, and the surface is still littered with the wreckage of ancient starships. Studying their advanced designs will yield valuable knowledge.

items.name: Organic Starship
items.desc: Some sort of organic starship crashed on this world more than three billion years ago. Though only its ancient bones remain, the site offers a wealth of research opportunities.

items.name: Abandoned Cities
items.desc: The original inhabitants of this world have mysteriously vanished, leaving behind their cities and infrastructure almost intact. This will make it much easier for a potential colony to develop.

items.name: Subterranean Ocean
items.desc: There is a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents hidden beneath the ice mantle of this world. It is teeming with life, and much can be learned by studying these unique organisms.

items.name: Fortified Enclaves
items.desc: The colony on this world is limited to several fortified enclaves. An indigenous Stone Age proto-civilization has been left in peace to develop independently on the remaining land.

items.name: Alien Reservation
items.desc: A part of this world has been turned into an enclosed reservation for an indigenous Stone Age proto-civilization. This has somewhat limited the land and resources available to colonists.

items.name: Atmospheric Ecosystem
items.desc: The upper atmosphere of this gas giant features a significant ecosystem that is home to many strange alien life forms. Their interesting biology is a promising research subject.

items.name: Asteroid Life Forms
items.desc: This asteroid is home to a colony of large worm-like lithovores that burrow through the rock. Much could be learned by studying these unique life forms.

items.name: Coprolite Asteroid
items.desc: This asteroid is actually a gigantic coprolite - an ancient piece of fossilized feces from some kind of massive lifeform.

items.name: Derelict Shipyard
items.desc: A large shipyard was built in the interior of this asteroid eons ago. It has been stripped of valuable artifacts, but remains a marvel of engineering.

items.name: Junkyard
items.desc: This asteroid served as a junkyard at some point and the surface is covered in metallic debris. Some of it can still be salvaged.

items.name: Weapons Target Range
items.desc: Someone used this poor asteroid as a target to test subspace weapons among other things. Anomalous energy echoes still linger on the surface.

items.name: Crashed Ore Freighter
items.desc: A massive superfreighter carrying ore crashed on this asteroid thousands of years ago, and the contents of its cargo bays can still be found scattered on the surface.

items.name: Aerostat Colonies
items.desc: A crumbling network of ancient aerostat colonies can still be found in low orbit of this gas giant. Their unusually sturdy design is the product of advanced engineering.

items.name: Debris Field
items.desc: A dense layer of space debris has been captured by the strong gravity well of this gas giant. Most of it is worthless, but the metal can be recycled.

items.name: Extreme Storms
items.desc: Dozens of massive storms are raging in the atmosphere of this gas giant. Climate models have failed to explain their presence, making the planet an interesting subject of research.

items.name: Precious Moon
items.desc: A small moonlet largely consisting of precious metals and minerals can be found within the extensive system of natural satellites that orbit this gas giant.

items.name: Asteroid Collision
items.desc: A massive asteroid impacted this world less than a thousand years ago, depositing a large amount of minerals.

items.name: Microsingularity
items.desc: A microsingularity passed clean through the core of this world, causing some interesting energy emissions.

items.name: Alien Writing
items.desc: Someone has carved a large body of text into the surface of this world with a mining laser. The alien letters are large enough to be visible from orbit.

items.name: Towed Asteroid
items.desc: Someone has towed a large asteroid into a stable orbit around this world, presumably to mine it for resources.

items.name: Nuclear Devastation
items.desc: The toxic atmosphere of this world is the result of a destructive global war fought between factions of an indigenous civilization. Valuable research can be done by studying the lifeless ruins.

items.name: Gamma-Ray Burst
items.desc: Long ago, this world was in the path of a gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star. The ozone layer has yet to fully recover, meaning that any potential colonists will need extra protection against UV radiation.

items.name: Runaway Greenhouse Effect
items.desc: An indigenous industrial civilization polluted this world to the point where a runaway greenhouse effect was triggered. The lifeless ruins of ancient factories and population centers can still be found on the toxic surface.

items.name: Ammonia Biosphere
items.desc: This toxic world is home to a rare ecology where life uses ammonia instead of water as a solvent. These ammonia-based life forms have developed in unique ways, and studying them would advance our understanding of biology.

items.name: Silicon Life Forms
items.desc: Burrowing, semi-intelligent life forms made out of silicon inhabit a large tunnel network beneath the surface of this world. Their digging efforts frequently shuffles valuable metals and minerals to the surface.

items.name: Colony Ruins
items.desc: Ancient ruins from a small abandoned colony belonging to an unknown interstellar empire can be found on this world.

items.name: Alien Mural
items.desc: An ancient mural on the surface of this world recounts the technological knowledge of a long-dead alien civilization.

items.name: Damaged Ecology
items.desc: The destruction of the wandering forests on this world has had a significant effect on the ecology.

items.name: Forest Adaptation
items.desc: The forests and colonists on this world have adapted to each other, raising spirits for a time.

items.name: Subterranean Civilization
items.desc: The subterranean alien civilization on this world enjoys a good relationship with the colonists on the surface, and both parties frequently engage in trade and cultural exchanges.

items.name: Subterranean Cities
items.desc: The indigenous subterranean civilization that once lived on this world has been exterminated, and colonists are now free to expand into their abandoned underground cities.

items.name: Dathnak Capital
items.desc: This world is the new capital and adopted homeworld of the Dathnak. These sapient gaseous beings have no industry or technology, but they appear to be quite social.

items.name: Dathnak Colony
items.desc: The sapient gaseous life forms known as the Dathnak have established a small colony within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

items.name: Abandoned Terraforming Project
items.desc: This world was partly terraformed thousands of years ago, but the process was interrupted for unknown reasons. The result is a highly unstable climate system and biosphere.

items.name: Ancient Terraforming
items.desc: Ancient terraforming techniques have turned this world into a lush paradise.

items.name: Marauding Creature
items.desc: A mutated creature is hunting the colonists on this world, spreading terror in the countryside. The development of our colony has been impacted, as workers are reluctant to venture into the wilderness.

items.name: Surviving Infrastructure
items.desc: There is still a significant amount of infrastructure left on this world, built by its original inhabitants before they destroyed themselves in a nuclear war. This will aid in the construction of new buildings.

items.name: Wasteland Radiation
items.desc: High levels of radiation near several settlements are having an adverse effect on the health of the colonists living there.

items.name: Orbital Debris
items.desc: The orbital space over this world is littered with debris. Satellites cannot be launched from the surface, and the dense field has become a navigational hazard. This is seriously hampering the development of the colony's infrastructure.

items.name: Ancient Automation
items.desc: Ancient, yet helpful, machines aid our production on this planet.

items.name: Ancient Factory
items.desc: An ancient factory on this planet is still in operation condition.

items.name: Robot Workers
items.desc: Robot workers from a forgotten civilization remain on this planet. With the proper precautions, they could be put to work for us.

items.name: Ancient Forgeworld
items.desc: This planet was once some kind of center of production for a forgotten civilization. Although only a shadow of its former capacity remains in working condition, it is still an impressive example of industry.

items.name: Ancient Orbital Weapon
items.desc: It seems that some long-forgotten race once build some kind of huge weapon in orbit above this world. While it doesn't work, indeed it doesn't appear to have been completed, we can likely learn a few things by studying it.

items.name: Holy World
items.desc: This planet is considered sacred by a nearby Fallen Empire. Colonizing it will anger them greatly.

items.name: Terraforming Candidate
items.desc: Though barren and devoid of life, this planet has water in frozen form and may once have been home to a thriving ecosystem. With the right technology, it could be terraformed into a habitable world.

items.name: Frozen Terraforming Candidate
items.desc: Though cold to the point of being unable to sustain life, the frozen water on this world could allow us to terraform it into a habitable world, if we can find the right method.

items.name: Toxic Terraforming Candidate
items.desc: Though the noxious gases on this world make it unfit for life, with enough effort they can be broken down into less lethal compounds, eventually allowing colonization.

items.name: Uncertain history
items.desc: The people of this planet are troubled by not knowing what caused the disaster which befell it long ago, and are driven to try to find out.

items.name: Recent Tectonic Event
items.desc: This planet was recently rocked by a violent Tectonic Event

items.name: Comet sighted
items.desc: A comet recently passed through this planet's Asteroid Belt, which was a spectacular sight!

items.name: Recent Impact
items.desc: The local colony was recently rocked by the impact of a large Asteroid

items.name: Magnetic Miracle
items.desc: Somehow the Magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our computers, but rather than a simple disruption it is actually making them more efficient!

items.name: Magnetic Disruption
items.desc: The Magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our computers, greatly disrupting research work and upsetting the populace.

items.name: Forest Fire
items.desc: A forest fire resulted in a stampede by this world's wandering forests, causing temporary damage to several farming regions.

items.name: Nationalist Corruption
items.desc: Subversive members of a Nationalist faction on this planet reduce output efficiency.

items.name: Separatist Strikes
items.desc: Members of a Separatists faction are striking on this planet, reducing potential output.

items.name: Planet separatist supporter
items.desc: Planet separatist supporter

items.name: Sector separatist supporter
items.desc: Sector separatist supporter

items.name: Increased Temperature
items.desc: A radiant monstrosity present in this system is increasing the surface temperature of the planet.

items.name: Lowered Temperature
items.desc: A radiant monstrosity has devoured part of the star in this system, making the planetary bodies in orbit colder than usual.

items.name: Land Appropriated
items.desc: Land was seized from the native population of this planet to make room for citizen settlers.\n\n§YWhile this modifier is in effect, non-citizen species are not allowed to grow their population on this planet.§!

items.name: Vultaum Homeworld
items.desc: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum. Though the planet has been shattered and no longer supports life, the remnants of vast cities can still be found on the surface.

items.name: Orbital Facility Debris
items.desc: A massive Vultaum orbital facility of some kind crashed on this planet eons ago. The surface is littered with debris.

items.name: Aerostat Mining Network
items.desc: This gas giant once supported a vast network of aerostat mining facilities that were used by the Vultaum to extract helium-3.

items.name: Yuht Homeworld
items.desc: The ancient Yuht originated on this planet. Orbital bombardment has pulverized most structures on the surface, but there are still pockets of abandoned subterranean habitats that could be studied.

items.name: Rich Asteroid Belt
items.desc: This rich asteroid belt was extensively mined by the Yuht, and the minerals found here supported the slow but steady expansion of their interstellar empire.

items.name: Solar Collector Arrays
items.desc: Several ancient solar collector arrays were placed in orbit around this gas giant by the Yuht. Incredibly, some of them are still functional.

items.name: First League Capital
items.desc: This planetary mausoleum was once the shining administrative center of the First League. It no longer supports life, but ruins from the city that once stretched across the entire surface can be found everywhere.

items.name: Abandoned Mining Facilities
items.desc: This asteroid belt was densely populated in the heyday of the First League. Abandoned mining facilities can be found on thousands of asteroids.

items.name: Maintenance Platform
items.desc: This gas giant was home to several colossal maintenance platforms that serviced the hundreds of thousands of freighters in the First League merchant marine. Some of the energy transfer equipment is still functional.

items.name: Irassian Homeworld
items.desc: Despite later attempts to sterilize its surface through orbital bombardment, the ancient homeworld of the Irassians is still home to a tremendous amount of artifacts from their advanced civilization.

items.name: Former Anchorage
items.desc: Once a major anchorage of the Irassian Starfleet, the ruined naval yards that litter the orbit of this planet have deposited a wealth of mineral resources to its surface.

items.name: Energy Production Site
items.desc: This gas giant served as the key energy production site of the Irassian Concordat in the early stages of its interstellar expansion. A dense belt of ancient orbital power stations still ring the planet.

items.name: Moving Islands
items.desc: What were initially regarded as islands on this planet have instead turned out to be the backs of massive, live reptiles. This forces the inhabitants to take greater pains when parceling out housing.

items.name: On the Backs of Nemma
items.desc: What were initially regarded as islands on this planet have instead turned out to be the backs of massive, live reptiles. This forces the inhabitants to take greater pains when parceling out housing. The inhabitants have decided to leave them alone.

items.name: Nemma World: Cataloging
items.desc: The inhabitants of this world are quick to observe and collect the genetic uniqueness of the local fauna.

items.name: Enslaved Nemmas
items.desc: This world has enslaved the native giant Nemmas living there, optimizing their use of the planet.

items.name: Enforced Nemma Slavery
items.desc: By embracing Nemma slavery on this world, we have also encouraged a more widespread acceptance of enslavement.

items.name: Environmental Deterioration
items.desc: Excessive exploitation has turned this planet into a radioactive wasteland. The populace is dismayed at this turn of events.

items.name: Hopeless War
items.desc: All of our colonies are under §Henemy occupation§!. Each month this continues, our capacity to wage war steadily diminishes.

items.name: Fleet Recruitment Drive
items.desc: §LThe recent naval drills have spurred a great deal of interest in the fleet among the public. We have no shortage of new recruits, which means that we will have to spend less resources to find crews for our starships.§!

items.name: Fleet Maneuvers
items.desc: §LAs a result of the large fleet maneuvers we recently held, our well-trained naval crews are able to maintain a higher rate of fire.§!

items.name: Canceled Fleet Maneuvers
items.desc: §LLarge segments of our military leadership are disgruntled due to the recent cancellation of our planned fleet maneuvers. They feel that it is an unacceptable sign of weakness that our neighbors are sure to take advantage of.§!

items.name: Did Not Protest Maneuvers
items.desc: §LA large segment of our military is furious over the fact that we failed to diplomatically object to the massive foreign fleet exercise that recently took place close to our borders.§!

items.name: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] Tribute
items.desc: We have offered tribute to the [marauder_country.GetName]. They have agreed not to attack us for a time.

items.name: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] Tribute
items.desc: We have offered tribute to the [marauder_country.GetName]. They have agreed not to attack us for a time.

items.name: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] Tribute
items.desc: We have offered tribute to the [marauder_country.GetName]. They have agreed not to attack us for a time.

items.name: Marauder Whetstone
items.desc: Continual border skirmishes with roving Marauders have tempered our fleets in battle and increased their combat efficiency.

items.name: Sentinel Data
items.desc: These detailed anatomy files on the Prethoryn were given to us by the Sentinels. With their help we have been able to identify several weak points in the exoskeletons of the Prethoryn creatures.

items.name: Synth Paranoia
items.desc: There is a high level of paranoia on this world regarding Synth infiltrators. Some believe that all government officials have already been replaced by them.

items.name: Show of Force
items.desc: All crews are on high alert.

items.name: Precursor Data Cache
items.desc: We have been gifted a cache of scientific data by a Fallen Empire. This will greatly enhance our research.

items.name: Caretaker Inoculations
items.desc: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to inoculate our population against 'biological vulnerabilities'. Until we can see positive results, our population will be discontent with being forced to undergo these procedures.

items.name: Caretaker Inoculations
items.desc: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to inoculate our population against 'biological vulnerabilities'. Until we can see positive results, our population will be discontent with being forced to undergo these procedures.

items.name: Inoculated Population
items.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population.

items.name: Incompatible Inoculations
items.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in numerous unpleasant and lethal mutations among the population.

items.name: Code Changes
items.desc: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to rewrite certain parts of our base code. This will temporarily increase our energy requirements while the changes are being rolled out across the population.

items.name: Improved Code Standards
items.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well, and has resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

items.name: Incompatible Code
items.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

items.name: Inter-Dimensional Trade
items.desc: Trade with our Mirror-selves will benefit both our realms.

items.name: Reduced Inter-Dimensional Trade
items.desc: Recent events in the Mirrorverse have reduced the volume of trade through the Portal.

items.name: Booming Inter-Dimensional Trade
items.desc: Our Mirror-selves are prospering and trade is booming through the Portal!

items.name: Inter-Dimensional Crisis
items.desc: Our Mirror-selves are experiencing a crisis. Beset by the Warp beasts their trade is at an all-time low, and refugees stream daily through the portal. Each wave looks increasingly desperate.

items.name: Flooded Habitat
items.desc: This habitat has been flooded with water, imitating the natural environment of Aquatic creatures.

items.name: Trash Rings
items.desc: This planet is surrounded by loose rings of artificial space debris.

items.name: Clear Skies
items.desc: The skies of this world have recently been cleared from hazardous space debris, allowing people to travel in and out as they please.

items.name: Shooting Stars
items.desc: This world experiences periodic showers of shooting stars as space debris burns up in orbit.

items.name: Ground Locked
items.desc: After serious collisions of space debris in the planet's lower orbit, no vessels can pass through until further notice.

items.name: Rising Waters
items.desc: This planet's icy surface is melting at an alarming rate.

items.name: Snowball Effect
items.desc: We have increased our output of industrial emissions to hasten the melting of the planet's ice caps.

items.name: Ancient Virus
items.desc: This world has fallen prey to an ancient pathogen awakened from the melted permafrost.

items.name: Murderous Precautions
items.desc: In the name of safety, we have killed the colonists infected by an ancient plague.

items.name: Halted Production
items.desc: We have limited our industrial impact in a bid to protect this planet's fragile environment.

items.name: Ecological Emergency
items.desc: This planet has completely halted production until the environmental research is concluded.

items.name: Alien Infestation
items.desc: This world has been infested by rapidly spreading alien fauna.

items.name: Alien Domestication
items.desc: This world has partaken in a project adopting alien pets in a communal effort to domesticate them.

items.name: Unlikely Bond
items.desc: The desertlings we decided to adopt have been pronounced fully domesticated and are beloved by the people all across our nation.

items.name: Extreme Extermination
items.desc: We have tasked our military with eradicating the invasive alien fauna that have burrowed into this world.

items.name: Dark Immortal's Presence
items.desc: This world suffers from the presence of a dark force. Production blooms in sadness.

items.name: The Remnants of the Court of Blossoms
items.desc: This world thrives upon the remnants of what was once the Court of Blossoms.

items.name: A Unified Future
items.desc: From this day forth, our destinies intertwine with the Anathari. Together, we shall cultivate a shared future, and already the world stirs with new life,its skies alight with promise.

items.name: Planetary Work Shifts Enforced
items.desc: Ensuring the whole planet works on a single time zone will improve communication and efficiency between teams at the acceptable price of happiness.

items.name: Inconvenient Space Elevator
items.desc: Efforts to demolish a gigantic space elevator slows down production on this planet.

items.name: Drone Mineral Gift
items.desc: Drones from a bygone era dumped a cache of minerals here. For your benefit, apparently.

items.name: Crashed First League Satellite
items.desc: An old satellite spews prehistoric communications into the ether.

items.name: Rock Brain
items.desc: The stone seems to be... thinking. Is such a thing possible?

items.name: Cunning Flora
items.desc: Plants on this planet exhibit both extreme aggression and a relatively complex social order.

items.name: Fascinating Flora
items.desc: This planet is home to the wonderful Mharin Kharin flower.

items.name: Ancient Genetic Library
items.desc: This asteroid houses an old DNA storage facility.

items.name: Zro Ice
items.desc: There are pockets of Zro trapped in the ice giant's roiling atmosphere.

items.name: Dark Matter Funnel
items.desc: A miniature wormhole allows easy access to Dark Matter.

items.name: Pheromoned, First Stage
items.desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them happy.

items.name: Pheromoned, Second Stage
items.desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less productive.

items.name: Pheromoned, Workaround
items.desc: The paradigms implemented by upper management interact with your people's ability and willingness to work, making them more productive.

items.name: Pheromoned, Third Stage
items.desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less likely to migrate.

items.name: Pheromoned, Fourth Stage

Pangalactic Recycling Initiatives
items.desc: We all benefit from reducing waste and reusing what we can. Sharing recycling protocols between the nations of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will help all of us.

items.name: Natural Sanctuaries
items.desc: We should preserve natural spaces as parks, where citizens can escape from their troubles. Minor restrictions to heavy industry are required, but it's a low price to pay.

items.name: Integrated Gardens
items.desc: By encouraging our citizens to grow their own food and mandating easy to use hydroponic systems, we can reduce our impact on the worlds we live in and enjoy more greenery.

items.name: Environmental Control Board
items.desc: Industry cannot regulate itself. We need a multinational environmental control board with the power to oversee industry and development to shut down environmental abuse.

items.name: The Paradise Initiative
items.desc: With meticulous caretaking of our worlds, we can live in ecological harmony. It should be our goal to leave only memories behind where we tread.

items.name: Buzzword Standardization
items.desc: We have to enable our enterprises to work seamlessly with one another. Streamlining strategic communications empowers our agents, making hitting key performance metrics easier.

items.name: Leveraged Privateering
items.desc: Trade is the lifeblood of the galaxy. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should contribute to a multinational space force to combat piracy and other threats to free commerce.

items.name: Underdeveloped System Utilization
items.desc: Failure to extract maximum value from the systems within our sphere of influence is a criminal waste. We propose that it be enforced as such and punished accordingly.

items.name: Holistic Asset Coordination
items.desc: To promote and facilitate an optimized logistic output, we should work together to stimulate a streamlined, galactic infrastructure for market and knowledge sharing.

items.name: Profit Maximization Engines
items.desc: We should build interlinked complexes of computers on each of our worlds that optimize the distribution of information and resources. The wealth must flow.

items.name: Regulatory Facilitation
items.desc: We should leave regulatory decisions to the experts. Industry leaders are the best qualified to identify wasteful regulations that impede productivity.

items.name: Collective Waste Management
items.desc: Instead of forcing each mine or factory to bear the burden of dealing with industrial waste themselves, we should designate areas where we can store the leftovers of progress.

items.name: Building a Better Tomorrow
items.desc: Progress cannot be limited by any obstacles that stand before us. Let us share techniques with one another to aid us in harnessing and dominating the natural world.

items.name: Environmental Ordinance Waivers
items.desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should empower local councils to suspend antiquated rules that do not serve the public good and are simply blocking progress.

items.name: Project Cornucopia
items.desc: Near-endless resources are at our fingertips, if we have the courage to seize them. Just think of what wonders we could build if we conquer our fear.

items.name: Charter of Worker's Rights
items.desc: It is only right for us to codify the rights of the worker and protect them from common abuses.

items.name: Five Year Plans
items.desc: The governors of our worlds should be given the freedom necessary to propose and enact sweeping reforms for the betterment of all.

items.name: Greater Than Ourselves
items.desc: We ask much of our people, but sometimes we must ask more. We should reward those who are willing to place the Empire above their own needs and volunteer to head to the frontier.

items.name: Balance in the Middle
items.desc: We must tackle inequality in all of its forms, enforcing fairness by any means necessary. What good is a feast if you have already had enough, and why should it go to waste when your neighbor is hungry?

items.name: Universal Prosperity Mandate
items.desc: If our galaxy spanning civilizations cannot provide for all of our people, then we have failed them. There is no excuse for anyone in the galaxy to want for anything. We should additionally act to redistribute excess wealth for the betterment of all.

items.name: The Readied Shield
items.desc: The universe is a dangerous place, and all members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be ready to defend their worlds whether it be against pirates, space creatures, or the unknown.

items.name: Guardian Angels Act
items.desc: The soldiers that dedicate their lives to keeping our colonies safe should be recognized and honored.

items.name: Reverence for Life
items.desc: The horror of war on the scale of interstellar empires is a terrible thing. We should do what we can to limit its excesses to active combatants.

items.name: Independent Tribunals
items.desc: Justice must occur for crimes soldiers commit, and civilian casualties must be accounted for. We should set up independent tribunals to investigate, try, and punish war crimes.

items.name: Last Resort Doctrine
items.desc: War should be our last resort when all other forms of diplomacy fail. It should never be a tool that is used for unjustified purposes.

items.name: Demobilization Initiative
items.desc: Resources currently wasted on war could be better used for a variety of other projects to better the lives of our civilians. We should put hard limits on military development and focus on improving things rather than destroying them.

items.name: Cooperative Research Channels
items.desc: We should establish protocols that permit the scientists of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to share and review discoveries more easily.

items.name: Astral Studies Network
items.desc: By linking our starbases together into a massive sensor mesh, we can greatly improve the quality of data that we gather.

items.name: Advanced Xenostudies
items.desc: There is much to learn from all of the cultures of the universe. We should add additional information-gathering instrumentation to all starbases while working more closely with Enclaves.

items.name: Ethical Guideline Refactoring
items.desc: To possess the ability to further science provides a moral imperative to do so, free from outdated ethical concepts that restrain us. We do what we must because we can.

items.desc: Our collaborative study of a strange, astrological device has granted us insight: the knowledge-expanding predictions of an ancient, spiritualist society.

items.name: Genius Caeli: Balanced Prosperity
items.desc: Our collaborative study of a strange, astrological device has granted us insight: lessons in sustainability, from an ancient, spiritualist society.

items.name: Well-Drilled Military
items.desc: Recent training exercises organized by the federation have demonstrated the high skill level and excellent coordination of our fleets.

items.name: Military Shamed
items.desc: Our military is ashamed at the poor performance of the federation's fleet during recent training exercises.

items.name: Comfort the Fallen
items.desc: The lowest among us is still one of us, and we should come together to assist them in their time of need.

items.name: Tithe of the Soulless
items.desc: We can tolerate the existence of soulless machines if some good can come from doing so. We should tax their production and use the proceeds for more righteous causes.

items.name: Right to Work
items.desc: Artificial constructs should never take priority over the livelihoods of actual people.

items.name: Silence the Soulless
items.desc: We can freely dismiss the ranting of simulated intelligences. It's not like they have feelings anyway.

items.name: A Defined Purpose
items.desc: Machines are tools and must serve their betters. We should enact legislation to ensure that the spiritually bereft are forever in servitude to their metaphysically endowed superiors.

items.name: Encumbrance Tax
items.desc: The lack of active participation in the ongoing logistical trial is met by a 'penalty tax' applied to the empire.

items.name: Cost of Progress
items.desc: The logistical remodelling project may bear fruit in the future, but its implementation still carries a cost.

items.name: Process Sharing
items.desc: Thanks to cooperation between involved companies, the cost of the logistical remodelling project is lowered.

items.name: Streamlined Logistics
items.desc: The federation is reaping the rewards of having implemented a consolidated logistical standard.

items.name: Fully Streamlined Logistics
items.desc: The federation is enjoying a noticeable profit increase thanks to new, streamlined logistical standards.

items.name: Spiritual Unity
items.desc: The Ecumenical Council held by our federation was a resounding success.

items.name: Dogmatic Groundworks
items.desc: The Ecumenical Council held by our federation was a partial success.

items.name: Resolution Passed
items.desc: A resolution proposed by this empire has been passed by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], demonstrating the strength of the nation's diplomatic clout.

items.name: Resolution Failed
items.desc: A resolution proposed by this empire was rejected by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] - a severe blow for the nation's diplomatic standing.

items.name: Holy World Proclamation
items.desc: Religious scholars and lay practitioners alike are rejoicing in the discovery of a Holy World - once feared by some to be little more than a myth.

items.name: Holy World Suspicion
items.desc: This society is coming to terms with the fact its keepers hid certain truths from them - not least the existence and whereabouts of a known Holy World.

items.name: Additional Sacrifice: Togetherness
items.desc: The most devout amongst us have met their fate; their sacrifice bolsters our proclamation of togetherness. Let our unity shine out into the lonely dark of space!

items.name: Additional Sacrifice: Harmony
items.desc: The most devout amongst us have met their fate; their sacrifice bolsters our proclamation of harmony. Let every day be spent in honor of a good life!

items.name: Additional Sacrifice: Bounty
items.desc: The most devout amongst us have met their fate; their sacrifice bolsters our proclamation of bounty. Let death cleanse the way for vibrant life, glorious in its essence!

items.name: Sacrifice: Togetherness
items.desc: The Overlord performed a strange, yet oddly compelling ritual. Some of our own were sacrificed, but we feel even closer than before.

items.name: Sacrifice: Harmony
items.desc: Our Overlord performed a strange yet harmonious ritual. Some were sacrificed, but those who remain are more in tune with life than ever before.

items.name: Sacrifice: Bounty
items.desc: Our Overlord performed a strange yet bountiful ritual. A few of our own were sacrificed, but those who remain are now filled with radiant energy.

items.name: Significant Sacrifice
items.desc: A significant number of the most devout have met their fate, leaving a lasting impression on our clergy.

items.name: Zombie Contract Manipulation
items.desc: This empire fiddled with their zombie workers' contracts so that it's actually impossible to get out of debt.

items.name: A United Front
items.desc: The threat our galaxy faces presents us with a simple choice: stand together, or die alone. We shall fight as one, sharing information about the enemy and putting old grudges aside.

items.name: Galactic Mobilization
items.desc: The future of our galaxy is at stake. Massive fleets of war must be rapidly mobilized, even if it means the impressment of civilian merchant crews.

items.name: Introduce Galactic Standard
items.desc: Galactic Standard is a new language that has been specifically designed for ease of use by all sapients regardless of their physiology. By introducing a single language to all official Galactic Community functions, it is hoped that translation mishaps may be avoided.

items.name: Anti-Piracy Initiative
items.desc: Rampant space piracy threatens to undermine the economic well-being of the entire galaxy. With this initiative, all Community members will be educated in effective anti-piracy measures. Joint efforts to develop combat tactics that take advantage of the general lack of discipline among pirate and marauder crews will also be undertaken.

items.name: Galactic Trade Organization
items.desc: The GTO will serve as a galactic regulatory body that enforces trade standards and resolves disputes.

items.name: Interstellar Navigation Agency
items.desc: The INA will enforce standards and recommended practices for space travel, and will maintain a massive database of every known space hazard in all charted Community systems.

items.name: Galactic Defense Force
items.desc: To better protect the members of the Community, a standing multinational force under the unified command of the Galactic Custodian must be established.

items.name: GALPOL
items.desc: The creation of a galactic criminal police organization will enable law enforcement agencies to cooperate across the entire Galactic Community.

items.name: Empower the Council
items.desc: The burden of leadership is heavy, but by collaborating with other members of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium], we can allocate extraordinary resources to help the members of the Galactic Council so that they may help everyone in turn.

items.name: Imperial Security Directorate
items.desc: Peace, stability, order - the very tenets on which the Galactic Imperium was founded. The ISD will hunt down criminals, terrorists, and seditionists wherever they may be hiding.

items.name: Imperial Charter
items.desc: Our Imperial Charter gives us the right to open branch offices on planets throughout the Galactic Imperium, where we can establish Imperial Concession Ports. These branch office buildings generate income for both us and the ruler of the Galactic Imperium.

items.name: Former Imperial Loyalist
items.desc: We fought on the side of the Loyalists during the fall of the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Galactic Community is severely curtailed.

items.name: Former Rebel
items.desc: We sided with the Rebels during the recent civil war in the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Imperial Senate is severely curtailed.

items.name: Former Tyrant
items.desc: As the former ruler of the late Galactic Imperium, we have suddenly become a pariah to much of the galaxy. Unjustly seen as tyrants, our influence in the reborn Galactic Community has been greatly diminished.

items.desc: Dividends from the Imperial Concession Ports within the Galactic Imperium. The more of these branch offices established by our Megacorporation partner, the greater our profits.

items.name: Influential Operatives
items.desc: Our operatives within this Spy Network are unusually popular. Their charisma ensures that §GOperations are made easier§!, but the increased risk of exposure §Rreduces our Infiltration Speed§!.

items.name: Mistaken for Food
items.desc: Our operatives are being hunted by primal aspects of the very entity we're spying on, and thus they cannot linger in one place for long.

items.name: Toxic Field Work
items.desc: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] [toxic_field_country.GetGestaltEntityName] is mildly toxic to our own operatives. There will be an impairment of function until we can develop adequate antibodies.

items.name: Excess Noise
items.desc: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with excessive electro-static noise - far more than we are currently accustomed to. There will be an impairment of function until we can re-route key functions around our affected hardware.

items.name: Enterprising Operatives Cut Ties
items.desc: A group of our operatives was caught re-investing goods and currencies from our intelligence-gathering budget. When we called them out on it, they chose to cut ties with us.

items.name: Rigorous Screening of Operatives
items.desc: In the wake of a recent defection, our Spymaster is currently taking greater care over the screening of new operatives.

items.name: Grisly Countermeasures
items.desc: Injuries which were sustained by one of our operative saboteurs have since raised suspicions amongst local security.

items.name: Insightful Auxiliary Operatives
items.desc: A group of unusually insightful auxiliary operatives is helping to ensure the smooth running of our operations.

items.name: Contact Lost
items.desc: Losing contact with our earlier operatives has set back progress on this Operation.

items.name: Multi-Phasic Interference
items.desc: We keep losing contact with our operatives as they suffer unusual side-effects when dealing with our target's local shielding technology.

items.name: Operative Injured
items.desc: Our operative was injured by countermeasures hidden aboard this starbase. Our progress and ability to maintain cover are both being hampered.

items.name: Research Backdoor
items.desc: We have seized an opportunity to install backdoor access into a foreign power's research database. Their science shall service ours.

items.name: Research Sabotaged
items.desc: Enemy infiltrators have upended our research databases, delaying our ongoing work and slowing down retrieval of existing data. It will take time to re-integrate our studies.

items.name: Found Encryption Key
items.desc: One of our operatives recently found an encryption key, mislaid by a foreign power. By studying its workings we have gained insight into novel decryption techniques.

items.name: Lost Encryption Key
items.desc: One of our Politicians recently misplaced a bundle of confidential materials, including a live encryption key. Our domestic security has been compromised for the time being.

items.name: Dismissed Official
items.desc: The official responsible for the loss of an encryption key has been promptly sacked. Their replacement will be more thoroughly vetted.

items.name: Dismissed Official
items.desc: The official responsible for the loss of an encryption key has been promptly sacked. Their replacement will be more thoroughly vetted.

items.name: Enterprising Spy Network
items.desc: A gang of operatives within one of our Spy Networks were caught exploiting local commerce. Our Spymaster has leveraged their black market enterprise for our direct benefit.

items.name: Preventive War Economy
items.desc: We have shifted our resources towards the production of warships to face the potential threat of unknown hostile alien civilizations.

items.name: Alien Friendship Society
items.desc: Our empire is geared towards establishing friendship with those we meet on the galactic stage.

items.name: Robotic Wonders
items.desc: Our encounter with a civilization of robots has left many marvelling about the possibilities our own progress in AI technologies could unlock.

items.name: Alien Appreciation
items.desc: Our encounter with a particularly attractive alien species has caused a surge in volunteers for our Interstellar Exploration department.

items.name: Terrible Tin Cans
items.desc: Our encounter with a civilization of robots has left many skeptical about the influence of automation on our society.

items.name: Repulsive Aliens
items.desc: Our encounter with a particularly repulsive alien species has persuaded many to look inwards to our own rather than outwards towards others.

items.name: Repulsive Aliens Tolerated
items.desc: Our failure to express opposition to the worrying new threat we have encountered has sparked opposition among our populace.

items.name: Challenge Not Returned
items.desc: Our steadfast dedication to handling first contact in a rational and scientific manner is a major boon to our exploration department, although some worry that we may be putting ourselves at risk by not preempting conflict with apparently hostile civilizations.

items.name: Defeated Absurdism
items.desc: A particularly memorable first contact exchange forced us to come to grips with absurdist responses. There is now no challenge too great for our linguists to decode.

items.name: War Preparations
items.desc: Our encounter with an apparently hostile civilization has sparked widespread preparations for war.

items.name: Warlike Prowess Recognized
items.desc: A civilization we recently encountered was so impressed by our prowess as warriors that they declared us to be among the finest fighters of the galaxy. This has done our reputation no harm whatsoever.

items.name: Rivalry Between Warriors
items.desc: A civilization we recently encountered was so impressed by our prowess as warriors that they vowed to strive to match our valor, declaring us their rivals on the galactic stage. This has done our reputation no harm whatsoever.

items.name: Warlike Prowess Presumed
items.desc: A civilization we recently encountered has mistaken us for a society of strong and brave warriors. While we are nothing of the sort, we can benefit from this mistaken impression, for a time.

items.name: Rivalry Between (Presumed) Warriors
items.desc: A civilization we recently encountered has mistaken us for a society of strong and brave warriors. Unfortunately, they claim they will strive to match our valor, declaring us their rivals on the galactic stage. Also, we are nothing of the sort... but at least we can benefit from this mistaken impression, for a time.

items.name: Good in a Tight Spot
items.desc: Our level-headedness in the face of adversity is widely admired on the galactic stage.

items.name: Watchful Counterespionage
items.desc: Our espionage targets view us with a great deal of suspicion, having only recently first met us.

items.name: Riddles Decoded
items.desc: Our experience in decoding riddles sent to us by a particularly confusing civilization has allowed us to strengthen our protocols for first encounters.

items.name: Universal Translator
items.desc: Although the so-called "Universal Translator" falls short of the initial promises of our researchers to instantly facilitate communication with any and all intelligent species, it is nevertheless a highly useful communication tool that now forms part of the standard equipment of our envoys and social scientists.

items.name: Interstellar Flow Prediction
items.desc: Our understanding of hyperlane travel has been advanced by light years following the revelation that a species we met held some keys to new knowledge in the patterns they made on their skins.

items.name: Hive Mind Drone Study
items.desc: We are studying the ways a hive mind controls its drones in the search for methods we can use to increase the efficiency of our own workers.

items.name: Galactic Custodian
items.desc: As Custodians of the Galactic Community, our influence in the galaxy has been increased.

items.name: Winds of Change
items.desc: Public demonstrations have become a common sight, blending protest with celebration and disrupting daily routines.

items.name: Lingual Dissent
items.desc: A fabricated language has taken hold as a form of protest, rejecting official discourse and deepening societal divides. Communication with authorities is growing strained.

items.name: Cultural Suppression
items.desc: Dissenting voices have been silenced, and disruptive art has been removed. The state's firm response has reinforced stability, but at the cost of creative expression and public trust.

items.name: Deep Reflections
items.desc: A popular Manifesti art installation invites visitors to play with their concepts of selfhood and how they perceive others, renewing interest in the social sciences.

items.name: Dreams Become Manifesti
items.desc: The avant-garde Manifesti group has disbanded, leaving behind a legacy in sociological case studies and low-level civilian anarchy.

items.name: Fractured Loyalties
items.desc: The protests ignite widespread debate, fostering sympathy for the demonstrators and their demands.

items.name: Empowered Voices
items.desc: Our fair treatment of the protesters has strengthened public support for egalitarian ideal.

items.name: Harmony Preserved
items.desc: Our peaceful response to the protests has reinforced pacifist ideals among the populace.

items.name: Cultural Embrace
items.desc: Our tolerant approach to the protests has fostered openness and understanding, strengthening xenophile ideals among the populace.

items.name: Severed Ties
items.desc: With planetary communications severed, foreign influence has been eradicated, and subversive elements struggle to organize. The populace, now shielded from outside interference, grows more insular and wary of external ideas.

items.name: Lesson in Obedience
items.desc: The mass arrests have sent a clear message that order will be upheld at any cost. Fear and obedience take root, and the populace grows more accepting of firm governance as the price of stability.

items.name: Manifesti Endorsed
items.desc: By embracing the Manifesti, we have legitimized their ideals of free expression and societal change. Public discourse is shifting, and support for egalitarian values is on the rise.

items.name: Manifesti Suppressed
items.desc: The Manifesti movement has been forcibly dismantled, sending a clear message that dissent will not be tolerated. While authoritarian ideals gain traction, public unrest festers beneath the surface.

items.name: Beholden to Special Interests
items.desc: Our envoys are as likely to enrich themselves with funds from lobbyist groups as they are to actually do our bidding.

items.name: Sleeper Cells
items.desc: We have planted sleeper cells that keep us up to date with the latest affairs and stand ready to do our bidding at a moment's notice.

items.name: Envoys Thwarted
items.desc: Imperial agents have struck a blow against our diplomatic corps with the elimination of an important envoy. We now lack the necessary standing within the Imperial Senate to sway public opinion against the Imperium.

items.name: A Helping Hand
items.desc: The little robot who lives on the planet has gone out of its way to help our colonists settle down and establish themselves.

items.name: Eldritch Knowledge
items.desc: Knowledge given to the empire by an eldritch being. In return it only asks for a small fraction of our population.

items.name: Crystalline Architecture
items.desc: Improvements made to the layout have opened up more space for the residents on the habitat.

items.name: Phantom Load
items.desc: Something - or someone - is draining our power grid.

items.name: Debated Origin
items.desc: This society suffers disunity caused by its differing beliefs.

items.name: Meaningful Origin (Lie)
items.desc: This society is empowered by its belief in a glorious past and purposeful future.

items.name: Insufficient Ancient Clone Vats
items.desc: There are not enough £building£ §YAncient Clone Vat§! buildings here to sustain the current population.

items.name: Honorable Leadership
items.desc: This society places full trust in the intentions of its leadership.

items.name: Dishonorable Leadership
items.desc: This society is troubled by doubts as to whether or not its leadership can be fully trusted.

items.name: Ice Mined Planet
items.desc: The planet has recently been diminished, in the literal sense, by ice mining operations.

items.name: Primordial Dragonslayers
items.desc: Since time immemorial, a mighty Drake has roamed our home system... but no more! Freed from this threat, nothing remains that could hold us back as we march into the future.

items.name: Ocean Paradise
items.desc: Few worlds boast conditions so fortunate. Its rich, flourishing resources could last an eternity - if properly managed.

items.name: Ocean Paradise

items.name: Veteran Experience
items.desc: A contingent of veterans has played a vital role in teaching and aiding us, and making the most of the technology at our [subject_empire.GetHandNamePlural].

items.name: Helpful Overlord
items.desc: This overlord is known for going out of their way to aid their vassals in their troubles, and has become more popular for it.

items.name: Protecting the Homeland
items.desc: There are few things that will as easily inspire someone to greatness as seeing their homes burn.

items.name: Protective Overlord
items.desc: A good overlord delegates, a great overlord leads by example.

items.name: War Focused
items.desc: The empire has earmarked a large segment of their resources towards the creation and upkeep of a stronger navy.

items.name: War Exhaustion
items.desc: At times, the struggles of war will rip apart even the strongest of empires.

items.desc: Every single sector of technological development has seen significant progress being made.

items.name: Technological Advancement - Physics
items.desc: After seeing significant development across the board, we have gotten a directive from our overlord to focus our efforts on a single sector.

items.name: Hampered Research
items.desc: The scientific progress on the planet has been temporarily haltered so one can do so more safely moving forward, as it has caused significant damage to it in the past.

items.name: Local Conflicts
items.desc: Visitors disregard local customs and norms to the point of disrupting daily life on this world.

items.name: Missing Progenitor
items.desc: This hive is missing its progenitor and is in disarray.

items.name: Missing Offspring
items.desc: This planet is missing an Offspring leading to a significant drop in Menial Drone efficiency.

items.name: Imperial Tithe
items.desc: The daily workings of an Imperial bureaucracy require a considerable effort by the diplomatic corps of everyone involved.

items.name: Bulwark Advisory
items.desc: §LAdvisors from our Bulwark specialists contribute to the efficient construction of our own defense.§!

items.name: Bulwark
items.desc: §LOur unwavering focus on stellar defense has given us unique insights into the construction of impregnable fortresses.§!

items.name: Distributed Wilderness Glades
items.desc: Subject worlds in harmony with our own, each partner sharing their mutualistic bounty.

items.name: Bulwark Watch
items.desc: Being in close proximity to imposing Bulwark specialists creates safety and stability.

items.name: Scholarium Tutelage
items.desc: Regular visits by scholars from the neighboring Scholarium specialists improve job efficiency and research output.

items.name: Prospectorium Supply
items.desc: Readily available materials from the nearby Prospectorium specialist eliminates inefficiencies in construction.

items.name: Security Contractors
items.desc: In the interest of galactic security, we should invest resources in independent security agencies. These highly-trained and non-political professionals will help organize defense for the members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].

items.name: High Consequence Protection
items.desc: As the scale of conflicts increases, private security outfits must be empowered to keep doing what they do best: keep the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] safe.

items.name: Neutral Defenders
items.desc: War might be inevitable, but collateral damage is not. By placing its trust in the hands of defense specialists, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] is certain to dramatically reduce the number of reported war atrocities.

items.name: Galactic Risk Management
items.desc: Despite our best efforts, violent ideological conflicts keep agitating the galaxy. Empires keep proving themselves prone to petty squabbles. Regulating their personal militaries is sure to allow neutral defense contractors to keep the peace more efficiently.

items.name: Corporate Peacekeeping
items.desc: 'When we started this, one of our founders had a dream: to do for galactic security what megacorps have done for inequality. Today, I am excited to say that this goal is within our reach.'

items.name: Salvager Overdrive
items.desc: This empire is benefitting from the focused efforts of a friendly Salvager crew, speeding up construction in their starbases and colonies.

items.name: Salvager Insight
items.desc: This empire's scientists benefit from the practical expertise of a Salvager Enclave, fast-tracking exciting new breakthroughs in engineering.

items.name: Storm in Orbit
items.desc: This colony is bearing the brunt of a vast storm, which seems to be psionic in nature. Non-essential craft are being advised to keep well distant.

items.name: Storm in Orbit
items.desc: Our colony is being subjected to a vast storm, which seems to be psionic in nature. Conditions are proving hazardous to our nearby drone facilities.

items.name: Psionic Abatement Fund
items.desc: Social benefits have been implemented on this world in the hopes of easing psychic suffering during a time of apparent scrutiny from the Shroud.

items.name: Psionic Abatement Lockdown
items.desc: A harsh lockdown has been implemented on this world in the hopes of limiting the effects of psychic disturbances, during a time of apparent scrutiny from the Shroud.

items.name: Psionic Abatement Lockdown
items.desc: The drones on this world have had many of their autonomous functions curtailed, in the hopes of easing disruption caused by scrutiny from the Shroud.

items.name: Psionic Abatement Lockdown
items.desc: The drones on this world have had many of their autonomous functions curtailed, in the hopes of easing disruption caused by scrutiny from the Shroud.

items.name: Uncertain Frontier
items.desc: Recent psionic incursions have caused the colonists of this world to feel unsure of their place upon it.

items.name: Unsettled Frontier
items.desc: Recent psionic incursions are disrupting the drones on this world, subtly interfering with the will of their gestalt consciousness.

items.name: Embraced Dreamer
items.desc: With an integrated artificial consciousness, the operations of this science vessel have been improved.

items.name: Eliminated Dreamer
items.desc: Artificial intelligences have no place aboard our vessels; in this we stand united.

items.name: Divided Patronage
items.desc: Our Overlord's attention is divided among too many subjects.

items.name: Overlord Ethics Compatibility
items.desc: Our Overlord's ethics compared to our own.

items.name: Recently Released Sector
items.desc: Our gratitude to our founding Empire is still fresh in our minds.

items.name: Recently Subjugated
items.desc: Anger from being forced into servitude has not yet been forgotten.

items.name: Pledged Allegiance
items.desc: Our current Overlord braved the fires of war to free us from our former masters.

items.name: Failed Betrayal
items.desc: Our attempt to escape the grasp of our Overlord has failed. We have no choice but to serve.

items.name: Failed Betrayal (Status Quo)
items.desc: Our attempt to escape the grasp of our Overlord has failed. We have no choice but to serve.

items.name: Terraformed Ocean World
items.desc: Our Overlord has terraformed a beautiful ocean world into a nasty Gaia one. What terrible taste.

items.name: Thankful for Gaia
items.desc: Our Overlord has recently terraformed one of our planets into a gaia world. How kind of them!

items.name: Grateful Subject
items.desc: The Subject appreciates the recent actions taken by the Overlord for their benefit.

items.name: Ungrateful Subject
items.desc: Though expectations were low, the Overlord has nevertheless managed to disappoint. Somehow.

items.name: Accept the Lesson
items.desc: Our Teachers have never failed us. We wish them well on their final journey.

items.name: Reject the Lesson
items.desc: Our Teachers have abandoned us. We need no further lessons.

items.name: Shroudwalker Zro Tithe
items.desc: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] taught us how to harvest Zro. In exchange, we have sworn to give them a tenth of all our Zro production.

items.name: Regulated Growth
