items.name: Larionessi Resurgence
items.desc: After eons locked away in underground cloning vats, the Larionessi are ready to once more rise to the galactic stage.

items.name: Local Hive
items.desc: A small hive has been allowed to settle down on the planet. They occasionally help out with minor tasks - grateful for the refuge they have been given.

items.name: Abnormal Symbiosis
items.desc: The whispers emanating from the Monolith on this planet bring comfort to the pre-sapient inhabitants. They protect the structure as if their survival depends on it. Any interference on our part will lead to unpredictable ramifications.

items.name: Commanding Presence
items.desc: Through the sheer willpower of our leader, we are able to extend our empire's agenda across space, and force others to heed our command.

items.name: Strengthened Government I
items.desc: Our empire has focused on creating a better-managed and more stable government.

items.name: Strengthened Government II
items.desc: Our empire has focused on creating a better-managed and more stable government. Special courses and pre-screening for government positions are a prerequisite to achieving this goal.

items.name: Strengthened Government III
items.desc: Our empire has focused on creating a better-managed and more stable government. Special courses and pre-screening for government positions are a prerequisite to achieving this goal. To further strengthen our clerical staff, we have implemented new regulations. Only the most upstanding and loyal citizens can apply for the job.

items.name: Overburdened Council
items.desc: Given the tremendous bureaucratic strain in recent years to sustain incredible growth, the council has encountered difficulties adjusting to their growing responsibilities.

items.name: Pirate Raids
items.desc: Various pirate groups have banded together to conduct smuggling operations on our borders. The situation has greatly endangered our space routes.

items.name: Released Prisoners
items.desc: Reformists have demanded empire-wide criminal pardons. While most were being held as political dissidents, there is no doubt that some dangerous individuals were also released.

items.name: Faulty Comms Arrays
items.desc: Our standard communication arrays are faulty. They no longer provide proper connection to the faraway colonies on the edges of our borders.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove Faulty Comms Arrays.

items.name: Worker Strike
items.desc: Workers are overburdened, unhappy, and unable to meet excessive quotas. The titanic effort required of our citizens is clearly taking its toll.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove Worker Strike.

items.name: Military Dissidents
items.desc: Rumors indicate that a group of low-ranking military officers are dissatisfied with our empire's current approach. The group is trying to recruit more citizens to join their cause.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove Military Dissidents.

items.name: Rampant Nepotism
items.desc: Our empire is plagued by rampant nepotism, which hinders our operations. Positions are filled by friends, family members, and people with connections - not by those of merit.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove Rampant Nepotism.

items.name: Humble Monument
items.desc: This modest monument is a tribute to our glorious leader, who elevated our nation to the stars.

items.name: Rich Monument
items.desc: This opulent monument commemorates the first settlers who, along with our glorious leader, tamed these wild and bountiful lands.

items.name: Residential Monument
items.desc: This residential monument demonstrates the wisdom of our beloved ruler. It is both a piece of art and a comfortable place to live.

items.name: Democratic Tendencies
items.desc: Reports state that the democratic faction is quickly gaining supporters. Our security forces are currently observing their growth and behavior.

items.name: Democratic Factions
items.desc: Reports state that the democratic faction is quickly gaining supporters. Our security forces are currently observing their growth and behavior.

items.name: Sustaining Apparatus
items.desc: This extraordinary contraption is nestled deep within the government building. A relic of the ingenuity of our beloved ruler, its inner workings are almost magical to us. It allows us to sustain the life of our ruler. The capsule is tailored to only one specific DNA sequence. Losing or moving our capital will mean certain death for the one encased within it.

items.name: Massive Strikes!
items.desc: Due to our broken promise, ordinary citizens are protesting on almost every planet across the empire.

items.name: A Great Loss
items.desc: The Luminary is dead! This news has rocked the populace. The sudden lack of leadership has left society reeling, as multiple reforms are proposed and politicians contend for power.

items.name: Constitutional Freedoms
items.desc: We made a deal to placate our enemies. Concessions were made, and freedoms were granted, but we must ensure that they don't abuse this arrangement.

items.name: Constitutional Freedoms
items.desc: We made a deal to placate our enemies. Concessions were made, including granting them the freedom to pursue many of their agendas. They will receive special protections and influence over some of our legislative bodies. On the positive side, our citizens will reap some of the benefits, and are happy with their newfound freedoms.

items.name: Revolutionary Spirit
items.desc: We are a people renewed with a sense of equality and unity. Stronger than ever, and freed from our despot, we will rule on our own, for better or worse.

items.name: Freedom Fighters
items.desc: We look to the stars and beyond, to uplift and free others. Our renewed navy is ready to bring equality to the farthest corners of the galaxy.

items.name: Harmonized Society
items.desc: Finding inner peace has always been the goal of our community, and we finally managed to achieve it. Although we paid for it dearly, now it is time to reap the rewards.

items.name: Open Society
items.desc: The recent upheaval showed us that being closed to external forces can lead to strife and misery. We need to open ourselves up so we do not miss similar opportunities in the future.

items.name: Closed Society
items.desc: The recent upheaval showed us that being open to external powers can bring strife and misery. We need to safeguard ourselves from such threats in the future.

items.name: Ascetic Approach
items.desc: We learned our lessons the hard way. Our civil war taught us restraint and the importance of inner peace. Decadence and corruption must be opposed at every turn.

items.name: Progress Oriented
items.desc: The new society, forged in the fires of galactic civil war, knows the worth of their work. Together we strive to accomplish all of our goals.

items.name: Forged in Flames
items.desc: It was not enough to unite our people in the common cause of space colonization. Though the nation has been ravaged by civil war, loyalists are steadfast in their support of the throne, standing strong in the face of traitors who threaten their way of life and our beloved ruler.

items.name: Unified Empire
items.desc: For the first time since the Unification, our citizens truly stand together. With the recent reforms, our empire is stronger than ever.

items.name: Civil War
items.desc: After long years of civil strife, the population was at last united. But now, as we turn our gaze to the stars, a new source of conflict emerges. Once more we are ravaged by war, and the struggle for supremacy is upon us.

items.name: Pheromone Cocktail
items.desc: A gift from §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!.

items.name: Overgrowth
items.desc: This planet was terraformed by one of §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s Nuclei.

items.name: Ecosphere Pheromones
items.desc: Beneficial pheromones regularly released by §HContained Ecosphere§!, applying positive effects to the population.

items.name: Allergenic Nucleus Pollen
items.desc: Treating the injuries sustained during our failed Nuclei sample research attempt will take some time.

items.name: Molten Mineral Rivers
items.desc: This planet is plagued by frequent volcanic eruptions and a high amount of molten lava flowing through its inner crust, which is instrumental for mineral processing facilities operating on the planet.

items.name: Hostile Planet
items.desc: On this planet, flora and fauna evolved into a predatory eat-or-be-eaten scheme. They provide a lot of nutrients but will also actively hunt out other living creatures for sustenance.

items.name: Ship Junkyard
items.desc: This planet is filled with old derelict ships and a fallen orbital shipyard. It makes for a great place to scavenge for precious metals as well as old technology.

items.name: Pulsar Flares
items.desc: Half of the planet is battered by a nearby pulsar star. It turned this surface into an inhabitable wasteland, but it allows our research facilities to work on energy-related tech in a vastly accelerated manner.

items.name: Grateful Outcasts
items.desc: Showing great appreciation for the opportunity of a fresh start, these former outcasts have quickly taken to our ways.

items.name: Ungrateful Outcasts
items.desc: Being slow to find their place in our society, these former outcasts feel unwelcome and tend to express their unrest.

items.name: Criminal Outcasts
items.desc: Seeking to exploit our trust, these former outcasts have preyed on our kindness.

items.name: Public Funeral
items.desc: A great leader has been laid to rest following a public procession, bringing the people closer together.

items.name: Private Funeral
items.desc: A great leader has been laid to rest in a private ceremony. The general public have been denied closure for their loss.

items.name: Good Tidings
items.desc: The death of our long-serving leader has had the unexpected effect of bringing opposing parties closer. They are willing to work together to fix the mistakes of the deceased.

items.name: Pragmatic Approach
items.desc: The anatomical donation of our late leader has proved itself beneficial, continuing to bolster our academic endeavors.

items.name: Harmonious Passing
items.desc: As our great leader ascends to a plane of non-existence, we will find comfort and reassurance in each other.

items.name: Military Funeral
items.desc: A great leader has been escorted to their final resting place by a military parade, projecting our might to the galaxy.

items.name: Foundation of Peace
items.desc: To honor the late great leader, a foundation has been established to bridge the differences between our communities.

items.name: Reignited Traditions
items.desc: The traditional funeral rites which marked the passing of our late leader have reminded the people of their united past. The event has reminded us of our history, and reconnected us to our old ways.

items.name: To the Stars
items.desc: Our late leader has been sent on a new journey. Together, we are inspired to push boundaries, and keep moving forward.

items.name: Towering Memorial
items.desc: Our glory is commemorated by a towering monument.

items.name: Name on the Wall
items.desc: The name of the great leader has been immortalized alongside the names of all who have served our society.

items.name: Landmark Building
items.desc: A skyscraper bearing the late leader's name looms over the city, advertising their significance to the empire.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.desc: The buried roots of our former leader have sprouted once more, bringing about a new beginning.

items.name: Virtual Advisor
items.desc: An intelligent hologram, with all the experience of our broken down leader, serves us as a veteran ship advisor.

items.name: The Hive Endures
items.desc: The hive has lost a valuable drone. They will be replaced.

items.name: The Wilderness Endures
items.desc: The collective has lost a valuable symbiont. They will be replaced.

items.desc: Distracting data points, and false conclusions hinder our reasoning skills. We must purge all redundant information.

items.name: Efficient Council
items.desc: The council is strengthened by the removal of a negative participant.

items.name: Dysfunctional Council
items.desc: With the quarrelsome councilor retaining office, efficiency across the board has diminished.

items.name: Rare Inspiration - Physics
items.desc: Our scientists are inspired by cosmic phenomena, increasing their research output.

items.desc: Our scientists are inspired by cosmic phenomena, increasing their research output.

items.name: Rare Inspiration - Engineering
items.desc: Our scientists are inspired by cosmic phenomena, increasing their research output.

items.name: Confiscated Contraband
items.desc: The local smugglers have a lot of problems operating after their main storage was raided by security forces.

items.name: Unified Council
items.desc: Our council is unified in their goals.

items.name: Scientific Progress
items.desc: Thanks to the recent upswing in the scientific community, our researchers are more motivated to work on experiments and new technologies.

items.name: Severe Data Leak
items.desc: Our society is in uproar as the amateur responsible for the leak is still working as a high-ranking government official.

items.name: Data Leak
items.desc: Due to recent document leaks, our security systems are compromised and need a total overhaul.

items.name: Stylish Trends
items.desc: Aesthetics fads come and go, spreading rapidly among our citizens, and dissipating just as quickly.

items.name: Inspired Rhetoric
items.desc: Invigorated by a powerful speech, the people are inspired under the banner of patriotism.

items.name: Individualistic Tendency Approved
items.desc: Individualistic tendencies are mostly contained. Although there has been some commotion, we also have unique opportunities to study these phenomena.

items.name: Individualistic Tendency Discarded
items.desc: Individualistic tendencies are studied and corrected, creating a more unified mind in the process.

items.name: Empire Wide Scandal
items.desc: Citizens are protesting the decision to leave the scandalous councilor in position.

items.name: Scandal Dealt With
items.desc: Citizens support our decision to oust the scandalous councilor.

items.name: Aggressive Expansion Plan
items.desc: Battles are won with strategy, but strength remains the foundation of success. When applying force, it is best to do so resolutely.

items.name: Improved Fleet Logistics
items.desc: Efficiency should not be underestimated: By optimizing the output of our shipyards, our expansion will be that much swifter.

items.name: Trained by Hask'Guttra
items.desc: Our fleets have benefited from the knowledge of the great warrior, Hask'Guttra.

items.name: Coliseum Opened
items.desc: Though our warriors appreciate the chance to blow off steam, the kindled bloodthirst has led to some anxiety among the populace.

items.name: Industrial Network
items.desc: Complex shipping pipelines of §YFactorator Shuladun's§! making; highly efficient, but at the cost of the population's health.

items.name: Cruel Industry Experiments
items.desc: §YFactorator Shuladun's§! work to further industrial development is not risk free; a claim eagerly substantiated by those who survive his tests.

items.name: Cruel Experiments Prevented
items.desc: Industry workers rejoice at being saved from §YFactorator Shuladun's§! unsparing tests.

items.name: Population Reform
items.desc: For the good of the whole, our people should be prepared to give both life and limb. By comparison, these small changes are a kindness.

items.name: Forced Rehabilitation Programs
items.desc: Forgoing one's criminal inclinations takes work, and usually requires an external push. That push will be duly provided.

items.name: Criminal Reformation Programs
items.desc: Relying on pedagogy and improvements rather than forceful, preventative measures, these programs are conducive to a happier populace.

items.name: Army Officer Recruitment
items.desc: Reliable and loyal subordinates are vital for any commander.

items.name: Administrator Beryllia
items.desc: Salvager §YBorin's§! robot companion has taken to office work, helping to refine our procedures by putting her self-learning capabilities to good use.

items.name: Improved Crime Fighting
items.desc: A series of new legislation to fight large scale criminal conspiracies.

items.name: Population United
items.desc: Owing to §YVas the Gilded's§! popularity with the people and her skill at bringing them together, society as a whole has grown more stable.

items.name: Vanity Palace
items.desc: This monumental building is as grotesque as it is fascinating.

items.name: Prophesied Greater Destiny
items.desc: §YUlastar's§! proclamations about our future glory spur the populace to renewed fervor and purpose.

items.name: Malcontent Knights
items.desc: The knights are unhappy, and their discontent is echoed by the population.

items.name: Motivated Knights
items.desc: Our knights have found renewed vigor and enthusiasm despite the hardships of the quest.

items.name: Demotivated Knights
items.desc: The quest is long and the goal is far. Sometimes, it all seems a little... Pointless. Morale amongst the knights has slightly dipped.

items.name: Despair of the Knightly Order
items.desc: The long search for the Toxic God has ended in failure. With no further leads to explore, many question the point of continuing the quest.

items.name: Trophies of the Doomslayer
items.desc: Trophies and tales of a knight's journey through a hellish dimension. A source of inspiration for many knights and squires who yearn to one day undertake such a quest.

items.name: Stellar Culture Shock
items.desc: This planet may be free, but its populace are still adjusting to the sudden realities of a universe larger than they ever expected.

items.name: Free at Last
items.desc: The former slaves are finally free from their oppressors.

items.name: Unshackled Politics
items.desc: We are a people of many worlds, and our politics are no less diverse.

items.name: Homecoming
items.desc: Returning home has immensely impressed our people and reinvigorated our society.

items.name: Home World Found
items.desc: Our most recent homecoming has energized our population and galvanized society.

items.name: Restricted Emigration
items.desc: Limiting the right of free movement has proven unpopular.

items.name: Freedom of Movement
items.desc: Granting the right of free movement has proven popular.

items.name: Unity of Purpose
items.desc: As a people, we are united in our purpose and proud of our shared home.

items.name: Accelerated Synergy
items.desc: Encouraging freedom of movement has led to unbound creativity and a flourishing of science.

items.name: Social Synergy
items.desc: Encouraging freedom of movement has had great effects on our progress as a society.

items.name: Disturbing Discovery
items.desc: The unexpected news about our former home has upset our population.

items.name: Freedom's Price
items.desc: The deep divisions in our political culture have resulted in social unrest.
